All 10 tests pass, including the 3 new ones for `serve`.

Added `habit serve` (`src/serve.js`), wired into `src/cli.js`. It starts a zero-dependency `node:http` server on port 3000 that serves an HTML page listing each habit and its current streak, reusing `store.js`/`streak.js`; habit names are HTML-escaped. Tests cover the rendered HTML and an actual HTTP request. Decisions I made narrowly rather than guessing big: fixed default port 3000, no auto-refresh/live-reload, no way to add/mark-done from the page (read-only, matching "listing"). If you want more, options: (a) allow `habit serve [port]` or a `PORT` env var, (b) auto-refresh the page every N seconds, (c) open the browser automatically on start — I'd recommend (a) as the most likely next ask.
